workflows.goal: From the signed-in portal, open the YP Metrics app through its SSO link and read every dashboard, section tab and report view it lists.

steps.do: Click the "YP METRICS" link in the portal navigation (opens the metrics app in a new window)
In the metrics app open "YP Metrics - English"
In the metrics app open "PJ Métriques - Français"
In the metrics app open "Report Studio"
In the metrics app open "Report Scheduler"
In the metrics app open "Executive Summaries"
In the metrics app open "Report Covers"
In the metrics app open "Leads Dashboard"
In the metrics app open "Manage Leads"
In the metrics app open "End Customers"
In the metrics app open "Lead Tags"
Switch to the "Overview" tab of the dashboard
Switch to the "YP Network" tab of the dashboard
Switch to the "Website" tab of the dashboard
Switch to the "Print Advertising" tab of the dashboard
Switch to the "SEM" tab of the dashboard
Switch to the "Facebook Ads Management" tab of the dashboard
